name: Breaking The Law
overview: Scripture reveals that breaking the law carries serious consequences, as God’s ordained authorities are established by Him and resisting them is equivalent to opposing His ordinance, resulting in judgment. While believers must submit to governing powers, ultimate obedience belongs to God, as demonstrated by the apostles who prioritized God's commands over human authorities. The law serves to make us aware of sin rather than justify us, highlighting the need for wisdom and truth, and warning against falsehood which will not go unpunished.
